markdown:
Exalted jaathoom shuyookhs are ostentatious purveyors of dreams and nightmares. They can remain invisible like any jaathoom, but prefer to make themselves visible to better communicate and express their individuality through bright fabrics, expensive jewels, and flashy displays of excess. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 32 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 30 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 27 [Jaathoom Shuyookh](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2620) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 84 **Perception** +22; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Sussuran](/Languages.aspx?ID=111); (can't speak any language), cloud of visions **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +21, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +20, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +19, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +17, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +22, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +22, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +20, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +17 **Str** +5 **Dex** +7 **Con** +3 **Int** +5 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +6 **Cloud of Visions** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) 120 feet. A jaathoom has telepathy 60 feet but can only show images rather than speaking. **Items** _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) jambiya_ (functions as a [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)) --- **AC** 29 **Fort** +17 **Ref** +21 **Will** +19 **HP** 150 **Turbulent Skies** ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206)) 20 feet. Swirling winds make all squares in the emanation difficult terrain for Striding and [Flying](/Actions.aspx?ID=94) creatures. Creatures with the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5) trait are immune. The jaathoom can activate or deactivate this aura as a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait.
**Naturally Invisible** The jaathoom is [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) at all times. They can become visible or return to invisibility as a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait. --- **Speed** 25 feet, fly 75 feet **Melee** _jambiya_ +24 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)), **Damage** 2d4+11 slashing plus 1d12 electricity **Melee** fist +23 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199)), **Damage** 1d6+11 slashing plus 1d12 electricity **Ranged** crashing wind +23 ([Air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [range increment 50 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8+8 bludgeoning **Ranged** _jambiya_ +24 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)), **Damage** 2d4+11 piercing plus 1d12 electricity **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 30 - **Cantrips (5th)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66) - **4th** [Ill Omen](/Spells.aspx?ID=696), [Gaseous Form](/Spells.aspx?ID=129) - **5th** [Illusory Creature](/Spells.aspx?ID=158), [Illusory Object](/Spells.aspx?ID=160), [Nightmare](/Spells.aspx?ID=208) (×2), [Pressure Zone](/Spells.aspx?ID=1318), [Sleep](/Spells.aspx?ID=288) (×2) - **7th** [Plane Shift](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) (at will; to [Astral Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=8); Elemental Planes; or [Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=1) only) **[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=8)** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) The shuyookh transforms into a Small or Medium air elemental or aerial animal, such as an owl. This doesn't affect the shuyookh's statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes. **Hurricane Blast** ([Air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11)) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** The jaathoom moves all creatures without the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5) trait in their turbulent skies aura 20 feet directly away, clockwise, or counterclockwise. A creature avoids being moved if it succeeds at a DC 29 Fortitude save. **Impressive Wish** ([Downtime](/Traits.aspx?ID=49)) **Frequency** three times per year; **Effect** The shuyookh conducts a _wish_ ritual for the benefit of a mortal, requiring no cost or secondary casters. The shuyookh's result is a success if they succeed at a DC 5 flat check or a failure if not. The shuyookh's visions of the subject's future inform how it interprets the wish. **Ominous Dreams** ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) The jaathoom sends a prophetic dream into the mind of a sleeping creature within 60 feet. An unwilling creature can avoid the vision if it succeeds at a DC 32 Will save. The jaathoom chooses the dream's subject but not its exact events. The target sees a brief vision of its future related to that subject, with the effect of [_augury_](/Spells.aspx?ID=15). If the result is bad or mixed, the creature is [frightened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) and doesn't start to recover from being frightened until it wakes.
Lady Dariya's Dazzling Emporium The reclusive jaathoom gem dealer and silversmith Lady Dariya crafts enchanted jewelry out of rare and unusual planar materials. She operates Lady Dariya's Dazzling Emporium in Shadow Absalom. She's also on rocky footing with Armun Kelisk and rumored to be in exile from the [Plane of Air](/Planes.aspx?ID=4) now that [Ranginori](/Deities.aspx?ID=106) has returned.
